raw.notable_prerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
raw.notes: As Urabrask's Forge will keep gaining oil counters, the creature token will keep gaining more power, eventually becoming infinitely powerful.
produces: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control
Infinitely powerful creature until end of turn
raw.steps:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Urabrask's Forge triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

raw.mana_needed: {2}{R}{R}, plus enough mana to cast the creature card in hand, if applicable
raw.notable_prerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand, or control another creature that entered the battlefield this turn.
You control any number of creatures that can tap to produce at least {1}{R}.
produces: Infinite mana creatures you control can produce
Infinite untap of creatures you control
raw.steps:
If needed, cast any creature card by paying its mana cost.
Cast Breath of Fury by paying {2}{R}{R}, attaching it to a creature you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}.
Activate Goro-Goro and Satoru by paying {1}{R}, giving creatures you control haste until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury and Goro-Goro and Satoru trigger.
Resolve the Goro-Goro and Satoru trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Dragon Spirit token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.
